en.sayed-ali-raza: and feel ashamed of running away, because it is a shame for posterity and (cause of awarding you) fire on the Day of Judgement.
and walk towards death with ease.
because Satan is hiding in its corner.
He has extended his hand for assault
and has kept back his foot for running away.
till the light of Truth dawns upon you.
“While ye have the upper hand, and Allāh is with you, and never will He depreciate your deeds.” (Qur’ān, 47:35)
